d: Long, flowing silver-white hair is styled into high twin-tails with straight bangs framing a youthful, adolescent face with heterochromatic eyes, one deep red and one bright blue. The slender build is dressed in a yellow sleeveless bodysuit with gold ornate detailing at the collar and blue patterned arm bands, paired with a gold fingerless glove on one hand. Pointed elf-like ears are visible beneath the hair, which is topped with a blue creature-shaped hat featuring a wide open mouth with sharp white teeth and two long upright ears.
